ZH_STABLE.scope: Alternative inclusive stable ZH production; external forced Z has the documented production-spin limitation

ZH_ZBB_STABLE_H.scope: Preferred MG5 Zbb resonant chain and stable H; the source Z decay must never receive another BR factor

ZH_BBGG_FORCED_DECAYS.scope: Future post-shower decay record; source LHE validation alone cannot validate this profile

weight_policy: Preserve raw LHE and actual Info/converter columns. An observed, complete BR-inclusion ledger determines only missing external factors; no unobserved policy is adopted.

ancestry.higgs: Two photon BIRTH records must have a direct H copy as unique non-photon mother and one uniquely identified original H lineage
ancestry.z: b/bbar BIRTH records must have a direct Z copy as unique non-bottom mother and one uniquely identified original Z lineage
ancestry.final_photons: Explicit selected stable direct-H-photon descendants, if present; conversion/loss can yield fewer than two and must not delete original events

future_native_detector.jets: Persisted native Delphes jets; PT>25GeV and abs(Eta)<2.5; native associated flavour, no hard-parton substitution
future_native_detector.photons: Persisted PT>25GeV, abs(Eta)<2.37, exclude1.37<abs(Eta)<1.52; leading PT>35GeV; separate H-decay truth association
future_native_detector.tags: Native BTag&1 retained; no redraw or forced second tag
future_native_detector.pairing: Two leading eligible photons and two leading tagged native jets; null tagged masses when fewer than two tags
future_native_detector.masses: Cartesian pair/four-object invariant masses; photon massless polar P4 and bounded signed native jet-mass convention from unchanged Phase6C

physical_receipts_required_later: actual MG5 generation and source-card/LHE/init hashes
actual full original source event ledger
actual pre/post initialization inclusive and forced decay tables/widths
adopted numeric BR source and uncertainty convention
actual native ROOT schema/readback for detector-stage acceptance
